title: VERY FRAGILE
text: VERY FRAGILE. ITS a good product but very fragile-- dropped it shortly after purchase and the bottom cracked. Still works though gonna add a silicone sleeve for extra protection

product_metadata.title: Maars Skinny Acrylic Tumbler with Lid and Straw | 18oz Premium Insulated Double Wall Plastic Reusable Cups - Birds of Paradise, 4 Pack
features: NEW & IMPROVED -- Increased 18 ounce capacity and redesigned press on lid allows you to sip directly or use the included matching straw
WORRY FREE -- Highest quality crystal clear acrylic is 100% BPA free and the sleek slim body makes it comfortable to take to go
NO SWEAT -- Double wall construction provides insulation of all your hot and cold liquids, such as coffee, iced tea, water and smoothies
EASY TO CLEAN -- Hand wash is recommended, but our tumblers are also top rack dishwasher safe, for days when you just don't have enough time
UNLEASH YOUR CREATIVITY -- All our new matte colors have a soft touch finish and are free of any logos to allow you to create your own custom designs and personalized diy gifts for friends and family
description: Constructed with the highest quality 100% BPA free acrylic, without any toxic chemicals and without the possibility of leeching. The acrylic material is both durable yet lightweight. It is crystal clear but won't shatter like glass, making it safer around kids.

The double walled construction reduces condensation and will not stain tables and countertops. Our double wall insulation technology reduces temperature loss and will keep your drinks colder and hotter than a regular cup.

Being able to hold both hot and cold drinks, this tumbler is temperature resistant and could be placed on the top rack dishwasher for a quick easy clean. The wide mouth opening and its 18 ounce holding capacity also makes hand washing effortless.
This cup comes with a matching lid and straw that are both BPA-free and dishwasher safe. The push on lid is attached by a rubber gasket that makes it both secure and easy to put on.
Use this tumbler for any occasion that fits your interest. Use it to travel to outdoor events and sports activities, personalize them for party favors and gifts, or just for everyday use.

Each tumbler is individually bagged and bubble wrapped to protect against scratches and damage during transit. Every tumbler will also come with it's own individual care tag as well as it's own individually wrapped straws.
